title: Portability: publish acceptance entrypoints and package edges
description: Objective: make every production subject used by the portability acceptance suite reachable through declared public package boundaries. After task-1e44b9b9d50e4cbab57a09d0105fdade lands the daemon importer edge, expose a real daemon stdio executable, a cycle-safe JetBrains ./host subpath, and the root acceptance dependencies needed for @moe/import, @moe/store, and @moe/jetbrains-adapter. HTTP continues through the already-shipped moe-mcp-http executable.
definitionOfDone: apps/daemon/package.json exposes a production moe-mcp-stdio executable backed by the shipped mcp-main entrypoint while preserving the existing moe-mcp-http executable; both launch from their installed package context without source-relative test invocation.

adapters/jetbrains/package.json exposes a public ./host subpath resolving the shipped host bridge, without re-exporting it through the root index or introducing the host's @moe/jetbrains-adapter self-import cycle.

The root package declares @moe/import, @moe/store, and @moe/jetbrains-adapter as workspace dependencies and pnpm-lock.yaml contains exact matching root/daemon importer entries after task-1e44b9b9d50e4cbab57a09d0105fdade.

Compiled and plain-Node probes from the root import/call public @moe/import, @moe/store, @moe/jetbrains-adapter/host and resolve both daemon executables; negative nonexistent-subpath/specifier controls fail with exact diagnostics, and all probes are deleted in-command.
Package typechecks and nonzero package tests for daemon and JetBrains pass; only manifest/lock paths are committed and no generated binary, probe, or scratch evidence remains.
taskRails: Hard-depend on task-1e44b9b9d50e4cbab57a09d0105fdade to avoid concurrent pnpm-lock/apps-daemon-manifest ownership.
Publish only existing production entrypoints; do not duplicate host logic, add a JetBrains command transport, or export deep test modules.
Public bare specifiers only; no tsconfig paths, project references, source-relative acceptance imports, loader aliases, or dependency inversion.
Own only package.json, apps/daemon/package.json, adapters/jetbrains/package.json, and pnpm-lock.yaml; commit by explicit pathspec and preserve foreign lockfile changes.
reopenReason: Governor promotion under the human's standing unstall directive: worker-filed prerequisite (acceptance entrypoints and package edges), BACKLOG was create_task default, not triage.
blockedReason: Fresh HEAD d2151d49 proves the task's DoD and ownership rail are mutually incompatible. `apps/daemon/src/daemon-startup.test.ts:98-117` parses apps/daemon/package.json and deliberately asserts manifest.bin as the exact closed two-key set {moe-daemon, moe-mcp-http}, with a comment that stdio has no bin. Adding the required enumerable `moe-mcp-stdio: ./src/mcp-main.ts` entry therefore makes the required full daemon package test fail; current baseline is nonvacuously green at 120 files/2476 tests. The task simultaneously requires daemon tests pass and says only package.json, apps/daemon/package.json, adapters/jetbrains/package.json, and pnpm-lock.yaml may be owned/committed, so the worker cannot update the exact closed-set test. Commit 9aa4711 confirms the prior moe-mcp-http publication had to change this same test atomically. A manifest-only plan would knowingly introduce a regression caused by its own diff and cannot use path attribution to excuse it. JetBrains also has only a source-relative host runtime test, not a durable public-subpath assertion. Recommended correction: split into (A) daemon stdio publication owning apps/daemon/package.json + apps/daemon/src/daemon-startup.test.ts; and (B) JetBrains ./host + root @moe/import/@moe/store/@moe/jetbrains-adapter edges owning package.json, adapters/jetbrains/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, and adapters/jetbrains/src/jetbrains-runtime-entrypoint.test.ts. Both slices can gate independently and stay <=4 files. Prerequisite task-1e44 is DONE and its daemon @moe/import manifest/lock edge is present.

priorHandoffs.whatIsDone: Remeasured every claimed entrypoint/manifest/lock/package gate, proved prerequisite 1e44 DONE, identified the exact daemon closed-bin regression, reported BLOCKED to governors, and wrote mem:task-task-f33028b5374044bfa84deb5ed979277b-handoff with two-slice correction.
priorHandoffs.whatRemains: Human/governor must amend/split scope to allow daemon-startup.test.ts (and preferably JetBrains public-subpath runtime test) before a truthful plan can be submitted.
priorHandoffs.pitfalls: Do not land manifest-only stdio bin: full daemon suite will fail by own diff. Do not re-export JetBrains host from root; publish ./host to the existing LF bridge.
priorHandoffs.openQuestions: Approve two slices versus one six-file amended task.
priorHandoffs.reason: Explicit architect handoff after filing a measured rail/DoD conflict; continuing the user's plan-more sweep.
